preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree must be between 2 and 300,000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in parents)
preconditions.description: All parent indices must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n for vi in queries)
preconditions.description: All query node indices must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the index of a centroid of the specified subtree.

postconditions.expression: any(size(component) <= size(subtree) // 2 for component in components)
postconditions.description: The maximum size of any connected component after removing the centroid must be at most half the size of the subtree.
